scope: Multivariate time-series anomaly detection benchmark family (SWaT, MSL, SMAP, PSM, SMD): dataset-origin papers, classic high-citation methods, and current state-of-the-art detectors.

papers.title: A Dataset to Support Research in the Design of Secure Water Treatment Systems
papers.method_summary: Introduces the Secure Water Treatment (SWaT) testbed and the labelled 11-day attack dataset used as the industrial control system benchmark.
papers.coverage_basis: paper title and publisher record; numeric claim table to be verified from an authorised copy
papers.access_note: Springer LNCS chapter; canonical SWaT payload is released by iTrust/SUTD only after a signed request form.

papers.title: Detecting Spacecraft Anomalies Using LSTMs and Nonparametric Dynamic Thresholding
papers.method_summary: LSTM telemetry predictor with nonparametric dynamic error thresholding; releases the SMAP/MSL anomaly channel subset and labelled anomaly lists.
papers.coverage_basis: paper title and dataset release; per-channel F0.5 table to be transcribed from the PDF

papers.title: Robust Anomaly Detection for Multivariate Time Series through Stochastic Recurrent Neural Network
papers.method_summary: Stochastic recurrent variational autoencoder with a planar normalizing flow and an extreme-value-theory threshold; releases the Server Machine Dataset (SMD).
papers.coverage_basis: paper title and SMD release repository; F1 table to be verified from an authorised copy
papers.access_note: ACM DL record is closed access; no confirmed open copy located during this sweep.

papers.title: A Deep Neural Network for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection and Diagnosis in Multivariate Time Series Data (MSCRED)
papers.method_summary: Multi-scale convolutional recurrent encoder-decoder over signature matrices built from pairwise sensor correlations, with an attention-based convolutional LSTM.
papers.coverage_basis: paper experiments use a power-plant dataset and SMD-style machine telemetry; exact coverage to be transcribed from the PDF

papers.title: USAD: UnSupervised Anomaly Detection on Multivariate Time Series
papers.method_summary: Adversarially trained autoencoder pair that shares an encoder and reconstructs from two decoders; robust to training-set contamination.
papers.coverage_basis: paper abstract and reported experiment table; per-dataset numbers to be transcribed from the PDF
papers.access_note: Semantic Scholar reports GOLD open access with a CC BY licence, but the ACM host rejects automated clients; a browser session is required.

papers.title: Practical Approach to Asynchronous Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection and Localization
papers.method_summary: Randomised anomaly scoring network with a per-signal autoencoder ensemble for asynchronous multivariate monitoring; introduces the eBay Pooled Server Metrics (PSM) dataset.
papers.coverage_basis: paper title and eBay release of PSM; F1 table to be verified from an authorised copy
papers.access_note: ACM DL record is closed access; the dataset itself is released separately in the eBay RANSynCoders repository.

papers.title: Anomaly Transformer: Time Series Anomaly Detection with Association Discrepancy
papers.role: SOTA anchor; defines the five-dataset protocol
papers.method_summary: Anomaly-attention with a prior-association Gaussian kernel and a minimax association-discrepancy objective; the paper's experiment table is the standard five-dataset protocol.
papers.coverage_basis: paper abstract and main results table; per-dataset F1 to be transcribed from the PDF

papers.title: TranAD: Deep Transformer Networks for Anomaly Detection in Multivariate Time Series Data
papers.method_summary: Two-phase adversarial transformer training with focus-score amplification of reconstruction error; reports on all five benchmark datasets.
papers.coverage_basis: paper abstract and result tables; per-dataset F1 to be transcribed from the PDF

papers.title: DCdetector: Dual Attention Contrastive Representation Learning for Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.method_summary: Dual-attention contrastive representation learning that compares patch-wise and channel-wise attention maps, replacing reconstruction with representation comparison.
papers.coverage_basis: paper abstract and result tables; per-dataset F1 to be transcribed from the PDF

papers.title: TimesNet: Temporal 2D-Variation Modeling for General Time Series Analysis
papers.method_summary: Reshapes 1D series into 2D tensors by dominant periods and models both intra- and inter-period variation with inception blocks; evaluated on the five anomaly-detection datasets.
papers.coverage_basis: paper anomaly-detection section; per-dataset F1 to be transcribed from the PDF

papers.title: iTransformer: Inverted Transformers Are Effective for Time Series Forecasting
papers.method_summary: Inverts the attention axes so variate tokens carry series-global representations; used as a strong channel-wise baseline in the anomaly-detection comparisons.
papers.coverage_basis: the anomaly-detection appendix reports the five-dataset table; to be transcribed from the PDF

papers.title: ModernTCN: A Modern Pure Convolution Structure for General Time Series Analysis
papers.method_summary: Modernised depthwise-separable temporal convolution with large kernels and variate-independent design; strong accuracy/efficiency trade-off in the Time-Series-Library leaderboard.
papers.coverage_basis: Time-Series-Library leaderboard lists this model across the anomaly-detection datasets; to be verified from the official PDF
papers.access_note: OpenReview PDF endpoint returns HTTP 403 to automated clients; the forum page is public in a browser session.

papers.title: CATCH: Channel-Aware Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection via Frequency Patching
papers.method_summary: Frequency-domain patching with a two-stage channel fusion module that scores channels and patches independently, then fuses them into a detection score.
papers.coverage_basis: paper abstract and result tables; per-dataset F1 to be transcribed from the PDF

papers.title: SensitiveHUE: Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection by Enhancing the Sensitivity to Normal Patterns
papers.method_summary: Hypersphere-based uncertainty estimation combined with a sensitivity-aware objective so that normal-pattern density, not reconstruction error, drives the anomaly score.
papers.coverage_basis: paper abstract and result tables; per-dataset F1 to be transcribed from the PDF
papers.access_note: Semantic Scholar reports GOLD open access, but the ACM host rejects automated clients; a browser session is required.

papers.title: GCAD: Anomaly Detection in Multivariate Time Series from the Perspective of Granger Causality
papers.method_summary: Models Granger-causal relations between channels with a causal graph predictor and detects anomalies as deviations in the predicted causal structure.
papers.coverage_basis: paper abstract and result tables; per-dataset F1 to be transcribed from the PDF

papers.title: TAB: Unified Benchmarking of Time Series Anomaly Detection Methods
papers.method_summary: Unified evaluation harness that shows reported anomaly-detection rankings depend on preprocessing, thresholding, and point-adjustment conventions rather than on the model alone.
papers.coverage_basis: paper abstract and benchmark scope; dataset list to be transcribed from the PDF

papers.title: The Elephant in the Room: Towards A Reliable Time-Series Anomaly Detection Benchmark
papers.method_summary: Introduces the TSB-AD benchmark and demonstrates that point adjustment inflates reported F1 on the classic five-dataset suite, changing which methods appear to be state of the art.
papers.coverage_basis: paper abstract and benchmark scope; dataset list to be transcribed from the PDF

papers.title: Unmasking overestimation: a re-evaluation of deep anomaly detection in spacecraft telemetry
papers.method_summary: Shows that spacecraft-telemetry anomaly-detection scores are dominated by evaluation-pipeline choices and that several reported spacecraft results do not survive a stricter protocol.
papers.coverage_basis: paper abstract and scope; numbers to be transcribed from the PDF

papers.title: Revisiting OmniAnomaly for Anomaly Detection: performance metrics and comparison
papers.method_summary: Recomputes OmniAnomaly-family results on SMD under corrected metric reporting, quantifying how much of the published advantage comes from the metric rather than the model.
papers.coverage_basis: preprint title and abstract; numbers to be transcribed from the PDF
